'''This [[Starship/Legends|starship]]''' was used by the [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Janna Relasi]] during her hunts for [[House Salaktori]]. She used the onboard computer to perform research on her prey. After a disaster hunt, a fatally-wounded, barely alive Relasi returned to her ship and, once there, asked her [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[GSAD-43]] "get them for me." To discover of whom her request pertained, GSAD-43 checked the ship's computer.<ref name="GG">''[[Galaxy Guide 10: Bounty Hunters]]''</ref>
